title: OpenHLM: An Empirical Recipe for Whole-Body Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
method: Original PDF page rendered with Poppler at 200 dpi, cropped only; no redrawing or generated images.

figures.original_caption_text: Figure 1: Overview of OpenHLM. A roadmap of controlled experiments in three phases: (I) we compare teleop interfaces for a low-level whole-body controller and adopt a joint-based interface; (II) we adapt a manipulation VLA to the humanoid’s full action space along several design axes; (III) we extend the policy to new objects and instructions by co-training the full loco-manipulation data with stationary teleop or HuMI [1] demonstrations.
